name: TLA+ / PlusCal
summary: Leslie Lamport's specification language that combines Zermelo-Fraenkel set theory with the Temporal Logic of Actions to describe concurrent and distributed systems as state machines; PlusCal is an algorithm language that translates to TLA+. Specifications are checked with the TLC and Apalache model checkers and the TLAPS proof system.

level_notes.1: No ISO/industry standard. The language is defined by Lamport's book Specifying Systems (2002, free PDF; Part IV is the language definition) plus the TLA+2 guide for the proof-language additions; the TLA+ Foundation's tlaplus/rfcs repository now holds a machine-readable grammar and conformance tests. PlusCal is defined by Lamport's two PlusCal manuals.
level_notes.0: SANY (parser/semantic analyser), TLC (explicit-state model checker), the PlusCal translator and TLATeX live in tlaplus/tlaplus (Java). Apalache (symbolic, SMT-based model checker, Scala) and TLAPS/tlapm (proof manager, OCaml) are independent implementations of large parts of the language.
level_notes.2: Book section links use #page=N into the free PDFs (PDF page numbers, not printed page numbers).
